name: Kawasaki Z900
engine: 948 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's big naked four. Early bikes had recalls for the rear shock mount, brake routing and ABS.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2017-2018 Z900s had rear shock recall 17V703, some 2018 bikes had brake hose routing recall 18V866, and 2019 ABS bikes had ABS unit recall 19V083.
A-002.reason: Each one affects braking or the rear suspension. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Rear shock frame mount holes can elongate.
Rear brake hose and sensor wire may touch the tire.
ABS unit debris may lock a wheel.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the ABS unit free (MC19-01).
